newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan's Q2 current account deficit widens.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's Q2 current account deficit widens.

text.p: Jordan's current account deficit widened sharply in the second quarter of the year to 197.2 million dinars ($278.5 million) from a revised first quarter deficit of 18.7 million dinars, Central Bank statistics received by Reuters on Thursday showed.
The country's balance of payments also slipped further into the red to 105.5 million dinars from a revised 26.4 million dinars in the first quarter.
Workers remittances, a key source of foreign income, fell slightly in the second quarter of 1996 to 249.2 million dinars from a revised 254.3 million in the first three months of the year:
